cases.disposition_reason: TablePro with no --page flag opens Connections at 120×40 in truecolor with reduced motion. The landing lists Filter connections and Development and does not show Query 1. A click on Development shows host dev-db.internal.acme.io and database acme_dev. Connect finishes on Query 1 in catalog acme_prod › public, with status ✓ Connected to Development and the empty editor placeholder Type SQL. The status is not Loading schema, and Cancelled is absent. Ctrl+Q exits 0.
cases.entry_path: launch tablepro --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40 with no --page flag; click Development; click Connect
cases.return_path: the workbench is already Query 1; Ctrl+Q exits

cases.disposition_reason: On Development, Query 1 receives two statements: SELECT sku FROM products WHERE sku = 't03_cancelled_first'; and SELECT name FROM products WHERE name = 't03_cancelled_second'. Development Safe Mode stays Silent, so Alt+R Run All does not open an Execute confirm. The running line contains running and ends in Esc cancels, and Cancelled is absent. Esc during that line, before a result body, leaves one result tab Cancelled, the result line Cancelled · nothing was recorded, the empty state titled Cancelled with hint The statement was stopped before it finished; nothing was recorded, and status Query cancelled. The screen does not show 1 row, No rows, Statement executed, or SELECT products. Both markers stay in the editor. The 120×40 frame is that cancelled body. The 80×24 frame, captured before the terminal returns to 120×40, still shows the title, the hint, the result line, and both statements. After both frames the cancelled title and hint remain, and 1 row is absent. Ctrl+Y opens Query history and does not list t03_cancelled_first or t03_cancelled_second. Ctrl+W closes history and returns to Query 1 with the cancelled body still shown. Ctrl+Q opens Quit TablePro? for the unsaved query; confirming Quit exits 0.
cases.action_sequence: Cancel before completion and, where the UI allows it, between statements.
cases.expected_results: The cancelled body remains the result. A later statement does not overwrite it.
cases.forbidden_effects: The batch continues into a success body after cancel.
